hero.description: Capturing authentic moments, meaningful stories, and cinematic visuals that stay with you.
hero.headline: Every frame holds a quiet truth.
hero.subheadline: Cinematographer & visual storyteller documenting intimate human moments, analog moods, and bold editorial narratives across the world.

about.heading: Behind every frame, there's a feeling.
about.subtitle: Cinematographer & Stills
about.paragraph1: I'm a photographer and visual storyteller passionate about capturing honest emotions, meaningful details, and moments that deserve to be remembered.
about.paragraph2: My process is rooted in patience, observation, and an obsession with light. Whether working with creative brands or filming intimate milestone celebrations, I strive to craft visual narratives that feel effortless, cinematic, and deeply human.
about.paragraph3: From the bustling streetscapes of Mumbai to secluded natural retreats across India and abroad, my camera serves as an invitation to slow down and see the unnoticed poetry of life.
about.quote: Great photography is not about asserting control over the scene; it's about attuning yourself to the story that is already unfolding.

pillars.title: Light & Atmosphere
pillars.desc: Harnessing natural golden hour and organic shadows to create depth without artificial stiffness.

pillars.title: Authentic Human Emotion
pillars.desc: Creating a calm, trusting space where subjects feel free to simply be themselves.

pillars.title: Cinematic Color Tone
pillars.desc: Bespoke color palettes grounded in warm earth tones, subtle greens, and soft film grain.

projects.title: The Wedding Story
projects.synopsis: A quiet, poetic documentary of an intimate celebration in Udaipur. We prioritized unfiltered human warmth, spontaneous tears, and twilight light over orchestrated postures.
projects.cameraGear: Sony FX3 · Sony 35mm f/1.4 GM · Leica M11
projects.quote: Om didn't just record our day; he immortalized how every second felt.

projects.title: Faces & Feelings
projects.synopsis: A minimalist studio exploration of natural light and raw expression. Stripping away heavy styling to let human vulnerability and the eyes take center stage.
projects.quote: A masterclass in restraint, quiet emotion, and honest lighting.

projects.title: The Art of Motion
projects.synopsis: Capturing the fluid poetry of contemporary dance fused with sustainable haute couture. Slow shutter speeds and deliberate motion blur create impressionistic gestures.
projects.cameraGear: Canon EOS R5 · RF 50mm f/1.2 L USM
projects.quote: The garments breathe and flow as if woven from the air itself.

projects.title: Tokyo Midnight Run
projects.synopsis: A neon-bathed nocturnal journey through the subterranean expressways of Shinjuku. High frame-rate captures of tire smoke, headlight trails, and asphalt reflections.
projects.quote: The closest visual feeling to velocity frozen inside liquid amber.

projects.title: Brutalist Monoliths
projects.synopsis: A study of geometrical brutalism meeting morning golden light across South Mumbai. Juxtaposing colossal heritage stone facades with fleeting pedestrian silhouettes.
projects.quote: Every shadow in these frames holds a century of silent stories.

projects.title: Terra Botanics Apothecary
projects.synopsis: An understated visual narrative for an artisanal apothecary brand. Emphasizing tactile botanical textures, handcrafted amber glassware, and earthy palettes.
projects.cameraGear: Sony A7S III · Sony 90mm f/2.8 Macro
projects.quote: Our brand sales increased 180% following the campaign launch.

projects.title: The Quiet Pour
projects.synopsis: A visual ode to slow drip espresso and handcrafted ceramic vessels in Higashiyama. Warm amber tones highlighting morning steam and single-origin roast textures.
projects.quote: Every frame makes you taste the quiet reverence of the first cup.

projects.title: Misty Heights of Nilgiris
projects.synopsis: An organic visual journal across the misty tea estates of Nilgiris. Shot entirely with 35mm film emulation to preserve grain, nostalgic sun flares, and earthy tones.
projects.quote: Photographs that smell of petrichor and early morning mist.

projects.title: Lanterns of Solitude
projects.synopsis: Immersed in Chiang Mai's Yi Peng sky lantern ascension. Capturing thousands of buoyant paper luminaries floating into the midnight atmosphere.
projects.quote: A constellation storm drifting into the stars.

projects.title: Golden Solitude
projects.synopsis: Gentle portrait study capturing the golden twilight hour across coastal cliffs. Completely unscripted poses, natural hair caught in sea breeze, and warm skin undertones.

projects.title: Midnight Walkers
projects.synopsis: A fashion lookbook campaign set within bustling neon retail districts. Heavy contrasts, chrome storefront reflections, and movement-ready silhouettes.
projects.quote: A vision of urban streetwear that feels both futuristic and timeless.

visualDesigns.title: Midnight Underground Supercar Drift
visualDesigns.description: Moody, high-contrast night aesthetics combining red taillight streaks with metallic gloss reflections.

visualDesigns.title: Neo-Tokyo Rain & Reflections Cinematic
visualDesigns.description: Atmospheric concept visual built with multi-layered neon reflections, futuristic Japanese typography, and moody depth of field.

visualDesigns.title: Desert Mirage Music & Arts Festival
visualDesigns.description: Electric festival key art capturing golden hour pyrotechnics, stage silhouettes, and vibrant community energy.

visualDesigns.title: Origin Craft Coffee Brand Kit & Packaging
visualDesigns.description: Clean artisanal identity system featuring warm monochrome packaging typography, textured paper stock, and earthy palettes.
